q2_gaps: attributive PROPER-NOUN modifier expressing an of-relation ('Madison County populations' = the populations of Madison County): the Possessive/genitive NP rule is keyed to 's, a possessive pronoun or a genitive of-phrase, and Compound concepts explicitly excludes proper nouns, so the compound has no stated encoding (the parse extends Possession by analogy)

coordination reduction of a shared head noun across proper names ('Vermillion, Posey and Madison County' = three <X> County names): Coordination & plurals covers coordinated clauses/VPs/NPs but not an elided shared head inside a multi-word name, so the reconstructed Name strings 'Vermillion County' / 'Posey County' are not literally surface forms
notes: Distribution over the three coordinated counties, the intransitive change-of-state Patient on 'decline', and Future are all per spec. The only questionable atoms are the two reconstructed Name strings for the elided conjuncts, which I judge correct under coordination reduction but which the string-literal surface-form rule does not explicitly license.
